steps.title: Unplug computers and electronics
steps.detail: Unplug computers, screens and the internet box so a surge does not damage them when power comes back.
steps.do_not: Never run a generator indoors or in a garage.

steps.title: If it lasts, follow the Outage plan
steps.detail: For more than a short cut, open the Outage plan: it covers working without systems, telling staff and customers, and restarting.
steps.why: A plan keeps the business running while you wait.

steps.title: When power is back, plug in one device at a time
steps.detail: Wait a few minutes, then plug devices back in one by one, starting with the internet box.
steps.why: Turning everything on at once can trip the power again.

steps.title: Still stuck? Call your IT contact
steps.detail: Tell them what you tried and what you see on screen. A photo of the screen helps.
steps.why: They can check settings and equipment you cannot reach.
